violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Residue at upper edge and at grate of toaster oven.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Warewash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. -Wash cycle on unit thermometer ~78F to 105F. Rinse cycle 188-197F. *Probe thermometer temperature on 3rd run found at 156.2F. *Manually sanitize dishes until unit is verified to be working properly.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Cloth used with sani spray stated as changed out weekly.

Use of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not used and/or applied according to manufacturer's label. -Both sanitizer solutions found with +200ppm Chlorine solution. *Sani sink should be maintained at 50ppm Chlorine, sani Spray should be maintained at 100ppm Chlorine.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Interior surfaces of table top oven has build up of residue.
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
